slides.text: Tools that learn on your data — useful or a liability?
slides.voiceover_text: More tools now promise to learn on your firm's data. Useful or a liability? Three checks before you say yes.

slides.text: Does the learning stay inside your firm?
slides.voiceover_text: One. Does the learning stay inside your firm? Or does it improve the vendor's general model? Two completely different things. Get it in writing.

slides.text: Can you delete what it learned, on demand?
slides.voiceover_text: Two. Can you wipe what it learned at any point? If the answer involves a support ticket and three weeks, that's not a real delete.

slides.text: Audit log of every decision it makes
slides.voiceover_text: Three. Insist on a full log of every decision. You need to be able to look back and check exactly what it did in your firm's name.
Learning stays private. Stays deletable. Stays auditable. All three. Or it's a no.
